title: How to Get Eskanoor (The One) in Anime Crusaders X (First Hero Unit)
excerpt: How to unlock Eskanoor (The One) by clearing 150 Hard waves in The One trial, plus his dedicated Hero slot and unique Hero trait pool.
content:
Eskanoor (The One) arrived in the Anime Crusaders X Anniversary Update as the game's first-ever Hero unit. Unlike normal banner units, he occupies a separate dedicated Hero slot rather than taking up one of your standard team deployment slots.

How to Unlock Eskanoor (The One)

  1. Enter "The One" trial in-game (you play using a supplied trial team rather than your own inventory).
  2. Clear 150 Hard waves in the trial to unlock Eskanoor.
  3. Once placed in a match, Eskanoor upgrades dynamically through takedowns.

Unique Hero Trait Pool

Eskanoor cannot roll standard banner traits; instead, he uses a dedicated Hero trait pool: Seven Sins, Sunspot, Shining, and The One. Pair Eskanoor with Kurimi (Time Queen) and AI (Idol) in Infinite runs.

title: Anime Crusaders X Vegeto Fusion Guide (Goku & Vegeta Requirements)
excerpt: How to fuse Goku (Goko) and Vegeta (Vejita) into Secret unit Vegito / Vegeto, pre-fusion trait tips, and level/evolution prerequisites.
content:
Vegito (commonly searched as Vegeto) is a Secret-tier fusion unit obtained by combining evolved Goku (Goko) and Vegeta (Vejita) via the in-game Fusion mechanic.

Step-by-Step Fusion Requirements

  1. Obtain Both Base Units: Summon both Goku and Vegeta from banners (use active Codes for Gems).
  2. Level Up & Evolve Both Units: Upgrade and evolve both Goku and Vegeta to their required pre-fusion stages shown in the in-game Fusion menu.
  3. Roll Pre-Fusion Traits First (Recommended): Community guides recommend rolling strong traits (such as Unique) on Goku and Vegeta before fusing, as pre-fusion traits can carry over or impact your final Vegito result.
  4. Complete the Fusion: Open the Fusion mechanic in-game once both evolved units meet the listed stage/material checks (exact material counts are displayed inside the in-game Fusion UI).

title: Anime Crusaders X Einz (Sorcerer King) & Mely (Assault) Evolution Guide
excerpt: Abilities, Crusader trait synergy, elemental stone evolution path, and team role breakdown for Einz (Sorcerer King) and Mely (Assault).
content:
Einz (Sorcerer King) and Mely (Assault) are two of the highest-impact Anniversary Update carries in Anime Crusaders X.

1. Einz (Sorcerer King) — Hill / Hybrid Carry

  • Role: Endgame Hybrid/Hill carry suited for Infinite and Progressive waves.
  • Key Trait Synergy: Frequently paired with the Crusader trait (+300% Damage, -10% SPA, +10% Range, 1-placement limit).

2. Mely (Assault) — Secret Ground Carry

  • Damage & Kit: Secret-tier Ground unit dealing Physical & Dark damage with Lostvein, Full Counter, Revenge Counter, Demon King's Mandate, and Swap Modes.
  • Evolution Path: Like other Secret units, check the lobby Evolution UI for the exact elemental stones (Fire, Water, Earth, Air), event tokens, and Legend stage boss drops required for her final form (exact counts vary by patch and should be verified in the Evolution UI).

Use our Evolution Material & Cube Planner to calculate how many stage clears you need once you check your missing stones in-game.

title: Anime Crusaders X Trait Reroll & Best Traits Tier List
excerpt: Which traits to keep on Hill, Ground, Hybrid, and Support units in Anime Crusaders X, and how many Trait Remnants you need.
content:
Rolling the right Trait can double your unit's DPS or cut upgrade costs dramatically in Anime Crusaders X.

Best Traits by Unit Role

  • Hill & Hybrid DPS (Goju vs Sukuno, Gilgamesh): Prioritize top Damage, Range, and Cooldown Reduction traits.
  • Ground Carries (Mely, Higuru): Focus on pure Damage and Attack Speed multipliers.
  • Support (Kurimi, AI Idol): Prioritize Range and Cost Reduction / Cooldown traits.

title: Anime Crusaders X Tier List & Placement Guide (Hill, Ground, Hybrid, Support)
excerpt: How to build balanced teams across Hill, Ground, Hybrid, and Support slots in Anime Crusaders X for Progressive and Infinite modes.
content:
In Anime Crusaders X, unit placement determines which enemies your team can intercept and how effectively you scale into Infinite waves.

1. Hill & Hybrid Meta

Units like Goju vs Sukuno (Heian), Gilgamesh, Barusu, and Ishtall dominate elevated lanes and flexible Hybrid tiles.

2. Ground Lane Carries

Pair your Hill carries with Mely (Assault), Higuru (Judgement), and Excalibur (King of Blades) to lock down ground waves.

3. Support Core

Never skip Support slots: Kurimi (Time Queen) and AI (Idol) multiply your entire team's clear ceiling.

title: How to Redeem Codes in Anime Crusaders X (32x Group & Lobby Guide)
excerpt: Step-by-step instructions to claim Trait Remnants, Gems, Stat Cubes, and Relic Cubes in Anime Crusaders X.
content:
Redeeming codes in Anime Crusaders X gives you free Trait Remnants and thousands of Gems for summoning meta units.

Redemption Requirements

  1. Join the official 32x Roblox group and favorite the game.
  2. Launch Anime Crusaders X and walk into the green Codes circle in the lobby.
  3. Paste an active code from our Codes page (note that ACCOMEBACK requires Level 20+ and ANNIVERSARY requires Level 10+).
  4. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.
